description: Connect to Kubernetes or OpenShift for enhanced observability. Learn more about Kubernetes or OpenShift in our documentation.

label.description: Renaming the cluster breaks configurations that are based on its name (e.g., management zones, and alerting).

constraints.customMessage: No leading or trailing whitespaces are allowed.

clusterIdEnabled.displayName: Connect containerized ActiveGate to local Kubernetes API endpoint
clusterIdEnabled.description: For more information on local Kubernetes API monitoring, see the [documentation](https://dt-url.net/6q62uep).
clusterIdEnabled.documentation: Enable this toggle when the ActiveGate is deployed to the same Kubernetes clusters you want to monitor. Disable it if you want to monitor a different Kubernetes cluster.

clusterId.documentation: Unique ID of the cluster, the containerized ActiveGate is deployed to. Defaults to the UUID of the kube-system namespace. The cluster ID of containerized ActiveGates is shown on the Deployment status screen.

constraints.customMessage: Please enter the external Kubernetes cluster ID.
This ID is invalid, it must match this pattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9]+([-][a-zA-Z0-9]+)*" (example: '550e8400-e29b-11d4-a716-446655440000')
This Kubernetes cluster ID is already being used.

endpointUrl.description: Get the API URL for [Kubernetes](https://dt-url.net/kz23snj "Kubernetes") or [OpenShift](https://dt-url.net/d623xgw "OpenShift").

constraints.customMessage: Kubernetes API URL Target must not be empty.
Kubernetes API URL Target is not allowed. Ensure the URL is correctly formatted and does not target private or internal network addresses.

authToken.description: Create a bearer token for [Kubernetes](https://dt-url.net/og43szq "Kubernetes") or [OpenShift](https://dt-url.net/7l43xtp "OpenShift").

constraints.customMessage: Please enter the bearer token of your endpoint.

certificateCheckEnabled.displayName: Require valid certificates for communication with API server (recommended)

hostnameVerificationEnabled.displayName: Verify hostname in certificate against Kubernetes API URL

constraints.customMessage: For security reasons, please re-enter all secret token(s) before saving the settings.

schemaConstraints.customMessage: Maximum number of monitored Kubernetes clusters reached. Please disable monitoring of some clusters.
